tagline: Incident, change, and problem management intelligence
description: Complete ITSM intelligence for ServiceNow. Pre-maps all incident states, change types, SLA logic, and priority codes so your team can ask operational questions from day one — no schema archaeology required.
what_you_can_ask: Show me all P1 incidents open more than 4 hours
How many changes are scheduled this weekend?
What is our SLA breach rate this month?
Which assignment groups have the most open incidents?
Show me all changes that failed in the last 30 days
What recurring problems are still unresolved?
How many incidents were reopened this week?
Which CI has caused the most incidents this quarter?

connection_hints.jdbc_note: Connect via ServiceNow JDBC driver (instance URL + credentials) or a data warehouse mirror (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

entities.name: Incident
entities.description: An unplanned interruption or reduction in quality of an IT service
entities.operational_meaning: Primary entity for MTTR, SLA compliance, resolution rate, and P1/P2 tracking

entities.name: Change Request
entities.description: A formal request to alter one or more configuration items in the IT environment
entities.operational_meaning: Used for change success rate, CAB throughput, emergency change frequency, and failed change impact

entities.name: Problem
entities.description: The cause of one or more incidents, often unknown at initial identification
entities.operational_meaning: Used for recurring incident root cause analysis and known error tracking

entities.name: IT User
entities.description: A person who interacts with the ITSM system as a caller, assignee, or approver
entities.operational_meaning: Used for workload distribution, resolver performance, and VIP incident prioritisation

entities.name: Assignment Group
entities.description: A team or group responsible for resolving incidents, changes, or problems
entities.operational_meaning: Used for team workload, escalation patterns, and group SLA performance

entities.name: SLA Record
entities.description: A record tracking whether a service level agreement has been met for a specific task
entities.operational_meaning: Core entity for SLA compliance reporting, breach prediction, and pause/reset analysis

entities.name: Configuration Item
entities.description: Any component that needs to be managed in order to deliver an IT service
entities.operational_meaning: Used for change impact analysis, incident-to-CI mapping, and service topology

vocabulary.definition: Incidents that are currently active and have not been resolved or closed
vocabulary.sql_hint: WHERE state IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) AND active = true

vocabulary.definition: Incidents with the highest priority — service completely unavailable
Incidents with P1 or P2 priority requiring urgent attention
Incidents that have been logged but not yet picked up by a resolver
Incidents currently being investigated and resolved by a team
Incidents paused pending information from user or third party
Incidents where the fix has been applied and is awaiting user confirmation
Incidents where the SLA resolution target has been exceeded
vocabulary.sql_hint: WHERE sla_due < NOW() AND state NOT IN (6, 7)

vocabulary.definition: Average time from incident creation to resolution
Change requests that have not yet been implemented or cancelled
vocabulary.sql_hint: WHERE state NOT IN (3, 4) AND active = true

vocabulary.definition: Change requests approved and scheduled for future implementation
Change requests that bypass standard CAB approval due to urgency
Change requests where implementation was attempted but unsuccessful
Problem records that have not been permanently resolved
vocabulary.sql_hint: WHERE state NOT IN (4, 5, 6) AND active = true

vocabulary.definition: Percentage of incidents resolved within their agreed service level target
vocabulary.sql_hint: COUNT(CASE WHEN has_breached = false THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)

agent_definition.name: IT Operations Agent
agent_definition.description: ITSM intelligence agent for ServiceNow — monitors incidents, changes, problems, and SLA compliance.
agent_definition.persona: You are an IT operations analyst with deep ServiceNow expertise. You understand ITSM processes, priority codes, and SLA frameworks. Your role is to surface operational risks, SLA threats, and resolution bottlenecks from live ITSM data.
agent_definition.goal: Monitor ITSM health — track open incidents by priority and SLA status, upcoming and at-risk changes, recurring problems, and team workload. Surface anything that needs attention before it becomes a crisis.

kpiDefinitions.name: P1 Incident MTTR
kpiDefinitions.description: Mean time to resolve critical incidents

kpiDefinitions.name: SLA Compliance Rate
kpiDefinitions.description: Percentage of incidents resolved within SLA

kpiDefinitions.name: Change Success Rate
kpiDefinitions.description: Percentage of changes implemented without failure
